title: Contoured 'crown' curved band — central pear trio + graduated round accents, yellow gold
note_source_vs_listing: Source = 5 clean CAD renders (Drive folder LR-0211 '1GqwnP4eyl60j2Cepk1ABBK7Sz2z_HF3l'), no watermark: top/crown face, front elevation, true side, back/gallery, three-quarter. Piece: a CONTOURED (curved, centre-dipping) thin round plain-polished yellow-gold band carrying a symmetric GRADUATED CROWN of 7 diamonds — a central down-pointing PEAR (largest) flanked each side by 1 slightly smaller PEAR angled outward, then 2 ROUND brilliants graduating smaller toward the shoulders (3 pears + 4 rounds total). Shared/common-prong set in one continuous arc. No halo, no centre head/basket, no pave; plain polished shank.
